title: Rates and Promotional Interest Disclosure — Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Rates and Promotional Interest Disclosure — Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The interest that applies to a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan is fixed by the promotional term the plan was written on. The disclosure below sets out, term by term, the rate that applies to the promotional balance during the term, the rate that applies to any balance outside the promotion, the rate the plan is repriced to after the missed-payment trigger, and the conditions under which the promotional rate is reduced or the held-back interest is forfeited.

## Rates by term

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Promotional rate on the promotional balance during the term | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 9.99 percent | 11.99 percent | 12.99 percent |
| Standard rate on any balance outside the promotion | 29.99 percent | 29.99 percent | 28.99 percent | 27.99 percent | 26.99 percent | 24.99 percent |
| Penalty rate after the missed-payment trigger | 32.24 percent | 32.24 percent | 31.24 percent | 30.24 percent | 29.24 percent | 27.24 percent |
| Reduction to the promotional rate while automatic payment is in force (percentage points) | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0.25 percent | 0.5 percent | 0.5 percent |

## Repricing and review by term

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Missed scheduled payments within the repricing review window that reprice the plan | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 |
| Consecutive months of on-time payment after which the penalty rate is reviewed and removed | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 12 | 12 |

## Held-back interest and term close by term

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Any balance left at the end of the term bills the whole held-back interest | yes | yes | yes | no | no | no |
| Calendar days before the end of the term by which the balance must reach zero for the held-back interest to be given back | 3 | 3 | 5 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Calendar days before the end of the term at which the expiry notice is sent | 45 | 60 | 60 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

## What the customer is told

1. **The promotional rate** is the annual percentage rate charged on the promotional balance during the term. On the three deferred interest terms it stands at 0 percent; on the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan it stands at 9.99 percent, on the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan at 11.99 percent and on the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan at 12.99 percent.
2. **The standard rate** is the annual percentage rate that applies to any balance outside the promotion.
3. **The penalty rate** is the annual percentage rate the plan is repriced to once the missed-payment trigger is reached: 2 missed scheduled payments inside the review window on the four shorter terms, 3 on the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan and the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan. The review window over which the trigger is counted, and the run of consecutive on-time months after which the penalty rate is reviewed and removed, is 6 months on the four shorter terms and 12 months on the two longest.
4. **The automatic payment reduction** lowers the promotional rate by the stated number of percentage points while automatic payment is in force: 0.25 percentage points on the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan, 0.5 percentage points on the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan and the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan, and no reduction on the three deferred interest terms.
5. **Forfeiture of held-back interest** applies on the three deferred interest terms and not on the three equal payment terms.
